notes: Camera arrival and opacity completion callbacks now advance moving stages. Reading holds start after arrival, and input remains locked until the return camera has arrived. Office pullback and door movement are no longer cut short by independent timers.

Student zoom is reduced from 1.45x to1.28x. Normal authored approach is900ms, reading hold1700ms and return850ms. Actual click-to-return times are retained in both browser reports and are about four seconds including browser actionability and rendering.

The classroom fades fully opaque before returning. The office camera resets while the opaque classroom remains mounted, then the office fades in before the teacher reflection. The reset is not exposed as a visible camera jump.

Email and student cues are plain glowing arrow strokes, with no circle frame. One unseen student is suggested at a time; arbitrary selection and keyboard focus remain supported. Student outline/halo rings are removed. Unframed portraits/checks retain all-three progress.

The enlarged invitation reads Come closer to take a look at the students. After Back to Office the two thoughts are They’re here, but they’re not really engaged. and What should I measure first? Successive captions exit before the next enters.

A complete Level1 chapter introduction now follows the office reflection, using the same ChapterTransition component and paper visual language as Levels2and3. A faint office backdrop bridges the change of presentation, one empty metric slot represents the upcoming choice, and the player name carries into Gameplay only after Choose a metric.

Level rules, metric text and Gameplay source are unchanged. Shared ChapterTransition adds a level1 variant without changing the level2/3 paths; those paths, standalone entries and the complete opening→Levels1→2→3 route pass the release suite.

The opening suite checks intermediate camera movement and stable arrival before dialogue, normal measured inspection times, sequential arrows, all-three gating, both office thoughts, Level1 introduction, name/button style, restored pages, touch and reduced motion. It passes against live source and actual offline full-game ZIP bytes.

All24checks passed with no runtime errors. Six current archives were generated together from the verified source fingerprint. All five partner PNGs retain their original hashes. No later authored cinematic was replaced and no Design Lab navigation was added.

Only animation/opening-integration is published. level3-dev and stable preview aliases remain at their preceding commits. Managed Chromium offline verification uses exact packaged HTML through an in-memory HTTPS route; direct local-file behaviour in a particular user browser and subjective smoothness are not established by automated checks.
